decisions.question: Through which data-access path does the view read a session's facts, keys and content, with what loading model and what cloud read policy? (Couples: dashboard plumbing — widen to the concrete Backend vs direct file reads; eager vs on-demand content loads under the 500ms TUI refresh; pull remote-only content with its local-write side effects vs metadata-only; where the shared session-snapshot derivation lives relative to handle_status.)
Where does the per-session content view live in the dashboard TUI: a new detail tab in DashboardTab, or an extension of the existing Summary tab / DetailData?

How does the workflow-view file carry the compact holdings summary (key names/sizes, count, total, anchor, store kind): inside the existing koto extension block vs new top-level fields vs encoded into existing preview/detail strings, and what contract-version bump shape keeps existing consumers parsing?

What exact shape does the one-shot single-session detail mode take on the existing dashboard invocation: flag name and semantics relative to the positional name argument, JSON schema, and error behavior consistent with koto's CLI output contract?
